pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Non-uniform, jagged-edged polygons with sharp pixel gradients at the interface with lighter pathways; patches vary significantly in spatial area across the observed flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous graph of light-colored pathways separating dark patches; characterized by wide pixel thickness and frequent Y-junction nodes.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple raised, dark, cauliflower-textured nodules causing hyper-pigmentation and significant textural disruption along the dorsal neck and shoulder region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark, circular focal lesion is visible on the lower posterior flank, separate from the dorsal clusters; numerous large, warty protrusions are present on the upper neck.
